summary: Daughter of Vincenzo Ferlaino and Maria Colosimo of San Mango d'Aquino, wife of Carmine Fiorillo; John's maternal 4th-great-grandmother.
bio:
Giuseppina Ferlaino was born at San Mango d'Aquino on 26 July 1811 and baptised two days later, the daughter of Vincenzo Ferlaino and Maria Colosimo; an elder sister of the same name, born in March 1810, had died as an infant. The Ferlainos were a long-established San Mango family, recorded in the parish from the 1670s onward.

She married Carmine Fiorillo, a contadino from Savuto in the Aiello area, in a civil ceremony on 1 March 1840 and in church two days later; their son Domenico was born that December. She was buried at San Mango on 1 February 1877, aged 70. Hers was an earlier Ferlaino-Fiorillo marriage, two generations before Leopoldo Ferlaino married Giuseppina Fiorillo. She is John's maternal 4th-great-grandmother.

researchNotes:
Tree: Giuseppina Ferlaino (1811-1877). Round 3 origins map gives her as 'b. c.1808'. Confirmed as mother of Domenico Fiorillo (b. 27 Dec 1840) in Nati 1840 act 79. Ferlaino is genuinely a San Mango family (229 entries in 1674-1804 stati delle anime).

Giuseppina was born on 26 July 1811 and baptized two days later, daughter of Vincenzo Ferlaino and Maria Colosimo ([R4-S1]). An elder sister of the same name, born in March 1810, died as an infant ([R4-S2]). Giuseppina married Carmine Fiorillo, a contadino from Savuto in the Aiello area, in a civil ceremony on 1 March 1840 and in church on 3 March 1840 ([R4-S3], [R4-S4]). Their son Domenico followed in December. She was buried at San Mango on 1 February 1877, aged 70, as the daughter of the late Vincenzo and Maria Colosimo ([R4-S5]). The index misprints her first name as 'Joseph'.
